loc.square.name: Village Square
loc.square.description: A cobblestone square with an old well in the middle. Paths lead in every direction.

loc.bakery.name: Village Bakery
loc.bakery.description: A warm bakery filled with the scent of fresh bread.

loc.forge.name: Blacksmith's Forge
loc.forge.description: Heat rolls off the anvil. Tools and half-finished blades hang on the walls.

loc.market.name: Market Street
loc.market.description: Colourful stalls line the street. A merchant waves at you.

loc.gate.name: Village Gate
loc.gate.description: A wooden gate marks the edge of the village. Beyond it, the wilds.

loc.meadow.name: Sunny Meadow
loc.meadow.description: Tall grass sways in the wind. Healing herbs grow among the flowers.

loc.forest.name: Dark Forest
loc.forest.description: Twisted trees block out the sun. Something green moves between the trunks.

loc.road.name: Old Road
loc.road.description: A cracked road. To the east, the mouth of a cave gapes in the hillside.

loc.cave.name: Goblin Cave
loc.cave.description: A damp cave that smells of smoke. Something glints among the bones in the corner.

item.herbs.name: Healing Herbs
item.herbs.description: A bundle of fragrant green herbs.

item.dagger.name: Rusty Dagger
item.dagger.description: Light and quick, if not very sharp.

item.sword.name: Iron Sword
item.sword.description: A sturdy blade forged in the village.

item.leather_armor.name: Leather Armor
item.leather_armor.description: Light armor made of hardened leather.

item.lucky_ring.name: Lucky Ring
item.lucky_ring.description: A small ring that seems to bend fortune your way.

npc.guard.name: Village Guard
npc.guard.description: A stern-looking guard watching the road.
dialogs: The roads south are dangerous at night.
Goblins have been seen in the forest.

npc.baker.name: Baker
npc.baker.description: A round, flour-covered man with a big smile.

npc.merchant.name: Merchant
dialogs: I could use some healing herbs from the meadow.

npc.blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
npc.blacksmith.description: A broad-shouldered woman hammering a glowing blade.
dialogs: A red goblin stole my best ore.

npc.goblin_green.name: Green Goblin
npc.goblin_green.description: A small green goblin with a nasty grin.

npc.goblin_red.name: Red Goblin
npc.goblin_red.description: A hulking red goblin guarding a pile of loot.

actions.sentence: The Red Goblin swings a rusty club.
The Red Goblin throws a burning torch at you!

q.herbs.name: Herbs for the Merchant
q.herbs.description: The merchant needs healing herbs from the meadow.
instructions: Bring the Healing Herbs to the Merchant.

q.red_goblin.name: The Stolen Ore
q.red_goblin.description: A red goblin stole the blacksmith's best ore.
instructions: Find the Red Goblin in the cave east of the old road.
